title: **A plan run holds the slot it
notes: `fhora`/`faccion=V`, which leaves the slot "Cita pendiente de confirmar"
at the AEAT: on 2026-10-28 two unconfirmed plans and one refused confirmed
run (missing `--email`) at 12:00 made 12:00 vanish from the offers, and it
was not booked (`gestioncita` showed only 12:30). Next: validate contact
details before any portal request, and in plan mode stop after the offer
list instead of preselecting the slot.
result: Plan runs stop after the offer list and never post the cita step with fhora; confirmed runs validate --out and contact details before any portal request.
evidence: pnpm check:ci green (2046 tests); bookAppointment and runAppointmentCommand tests assert 0 requests on bad contacts and no fhora request in plan mode
